url.description: WebP, labelled in the image itself with RENDER_LABEL and the depth
url.title: Url

depth_m.description: the run's peak water depth in this grid cell (cell average)
depth_m.title: Depth M

depth_text.description: the depth cue the image model was given, e.g. 'over the kerb'
depth_text.title: Depth Text

picture_depth_m.description: Muse Spark vision's estimate of the depth the picture actually shows (the image model tends to draw less water than asked)
picture_depth_m.title: Picture Depth M

picture_matches.description: picture_depth_m within max(0.1 m, 35 %) of depth_m
picture_matches.title: Picture Matches

RenderRequest.description:
POST /api/render: a ground-level picture of one street spot in two runs of the same storm (Muse Image).
Each picture is asked for the run's peak depth in the grid cell holding `center`; the change is the difference
between the two runs' scenarios. The deeper picture is generated from text and the other is an edit of it, so
the camera and buildings match. Additive in 0.8.0: run_ids and patch_ids are unchanged.

alt_run_id.description: 'after': the run with the change; same AOI and storm as base_run_id
alt_run_id.title: Alt Run Id

view.description: street: eye level from the road; window: looking down from a first-floor window
view.title: View

provider.description: fake: offline placeholder pictures, no cost
provider.title: Provider

RenderRequest.title: RenderRequest

render_id.description: cache key: same runs, grid cell, view, photo and provider = same pictures
render_id.title: Render Id

cell.description: [row, col] of the grid cell the depths come from
cell.title: Cell

place.description: named place holding or nearest to the spot
place.title: Place

photo.description: URL of the uploaded street photo (EXIF stripped), when one was sent
photo.title: Photo

changes_elsewhere.description: changes in the alt run that are not at this spot (they still change the water here)
changes_elsewhere.title: Changes Elsewhere
